comment: The embedded T3 server: the official T3 Code CLI release archive (Node single executable) of the Beta release v0.1.7, cut at the reference pin 322f6544df itself, whose version is CLIENT_VERSION (version-skew.ts). stage-runtime.mjs downloads it, checks it against the release's SHA256SUMS and this hash, checks every Mach-O file with `codesign --verify --strict` (the release signs them with a Developer ID), and puts it beside this file; the app unpacks it into <T3 home>/runtime/versions/<version> at first launch. T3 Code is MIT (LICENSE-T3).
